verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I flirt with the world
It steals my love for You

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
My fear grips my faith
And I am left unmoved

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
Your gaze stops my heart
Your voice fills the dark

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
Your love is the spark
That lights this life, so we rise

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Out of the depths you cry
Come and be satisfied

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Father, You sing
Father, You sing over Your children

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
You quiet the storm
Inside my shipwrecked soul

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Your spirit will lead
It calls the wayward home

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
At the sound of Your name
Our sin is washed away

verse.name: v2d
verse.lines:
In Christ we're crucified
In You we die, in You we rise

verse.name: c2a
verse.lines:
Out of the depths you cry
Come and be satisfied

verse.name: c2b
verse.lines:
Father, You sing
Father, You sing over Your children

verse.name: c2c
verse.lines:
Let us see through Your eyes
We are Your great delight

verse.name: c2d
verse.lines:
Father You sing
Father, You sing over Your children

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
And we're singing along
Your daughters and sons

verse.name: b1c
verse.lines:
We're singing Your song
We are Your children
